rules.T: first_listed_date midnight America/New_York; designation-day receipts flagged as intraday ambiguous
rules.check: recomputes exactly the saved timeline path set; verifies bytes of all manifested inputs; changed inputs fail, new files wait until refresh
rules.decay: age bins are descriptive counts, not causal decay; cohorts, missing history and unequal exposure differ
rules.deduplication: within recipient, hash plus event id or kind/trace/log/ordinal identity; no cross-address netting; transfer counts differ from transactions
rules.dust: <1 USD; zero on recognised asset is dust unless mimic demonstrated
rules.exchange_scale: >10,000 observed distinct transaction hashes or provider-reported history records; incomplete histories can hide scale
rules.one_time_large_or_dominant: largest event >=80% of observed real inflow value
rules.poisoning: token outside explicit recognised list (low-confidence operational spam bucket), or zero/<1 USD sender matching both first and last 4 characters of prior real outgoing counterparty
rules.real: >=1 USD at transfer time; recognised native asset/contract; no poisoning rule
rules.sender_counts: chain-address pairs; UTXO input addresses are possible funding sources, not people; no outgoing change addresses counted as senders
rules.sender_labels: public label claims, not ownership proof; no historical validity assumed where dates absent; cex_hot sender is a withdrawal lead only
rules.steady_drips: >=12 real events across >=6 UTC months, median <=100 USD, largest event <50% of total
rules.token_list_limit: off-list is not independent proof of fake-token intent; legitimate off-list assets may be false positives
rules.unclassified: recognised positive amount without saved transfer-time price; excluded from real/dust totals rather than inventing a value
rules.valuation: at each transfer; latest saved hourly observation within 2h, otherwise daily within 2d
rules.wrapped_assets: WETH valued using ETH proxy; WBTC and liquid-staking tokens remain unpriced unless separately configured
